summary_md: **Justin ([@justinn_builds](https://x.com/justinn_builds/status/2115133144492114277))** publishes a recipe for **MiniMax M3.1 Flash on two DGX Sparks** (EXL3 2.15bpw, TP2): 30+ tok/s single-stream decode, 1,500+ tok/s prefill and ~100 s boot, built on @ViC305's earlier launch.
relevance: A reproducible max-tier model recipe for paired DGX Sparks.

media.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 'Ready for liftoff' launch card for 2x DGX Spark: 1,561 tok/s prefill (8K and 16K prompts), 66.4 tok/s total decode over 4 streams, 30.8 tok/s single-stream decode; community recipe launch, validated Oct 27, 2026; mascot in an astronaut helmet.
